Overview

The Garmin Connect Developer Program makes it easy to create your own programs from valuable health and activity information as well as push structured works and courses to your users’ devices, all from this platform.

### Get Started:

- Check out the [Start Guide](https://developerportal.garmin.com/developer-programs/programs-docs) to begin your integration.
- Request API Keys [by creating apps](https://developerportal.garmin.com/developer-programs/myapp)
- Access API [documentation](https://developerportal.garmin.com/developer-programs/programs-docs)
- Configure your data delivery settings using [API Tools](https://healthapi.garmin.com/tools/login)
- Read the latest announcements and updates in the [blog](https://developerportal.garmin.com/developer-programs/blog)
- Questions? Browse our [FAQs](https://developerportal.garmin.com/developer-programs/faqs)

### STARTER ACCESS

The starting point for organizations building apps with Garmin Connect API access.

Build, test, and launch integrations using core Garmin Connect APIs.

ACCESS INCLUDES:

- ✓Activity API (JSON & .FIT)
- ✓Health API (JSON)
- ✓Women's Health API (JSON)
- ✓Training API (JSON)
- ✓Courses API (JSON)

**Delivery:** Push only

**Historical Data:** Not included

**User Capacity:** Up to 1,000 connected users

### ENTERPRISE ACCESS

Designed for companies operating at scale requiring capabilities beyond Starter Access.

Build with Verified Enterprise Status, expanded data access, premium capabilities, and dedicated technical support. Available options and commercial terms are tailored based on business and technical requirements.

AVAILABLE OPTIONS:

- ✓Activity API (JSON & .FIT)
- ✓Health API (JSON)
- ✓Women's Health API (JSON)
- ✓Training API (JSON)
- ✓Courses API (JSON)
- ✓Golf API (JSON)

**Delivery:** Push or Ping/Pull

**Historical Data:** 1 month+

**User Capacity:** Unlimited

**Technical Support:** Included

**Verified Enterprise Status**

**Activity, Health, Women's Health APIs**

- With event-driven notification integration for Activities, Health, and Women's Health APIs, it's easy to get real-time updates on all users in your program. No more scheduled jobs and hourly delays to fetch the latest data for your users -- instead, get update notifications delivered to you within seconds of the user syncing their device.

**Training and Courses APIs**

- Training and Courses APIs ensure your users have the information they need exactly when they need it most by publishing workout details and courses straight to their compatible Garmin devices.

With complete API reference implementation information and easy-to-use developer tools it is now easier than ever to make Garmin a part of your platform. The top-tier API support team is ready to help you get your integration up and running!
